descriptionPlain:
Join Spotify’s Talent Acquisition team and help us find and engage the people who will shape what comes next. As a Talent Acquisition Lead, you’ll partner closely with leaders and teams across JAPAC & SAMEA to understand their talent needs, proactively build thoughtful hiring strategies, and create an engaging experience for candidates and internal partners.
You’ll be a trusted talent partner to the business, bringing strong stakeholder management, recruiting expertise, mentorship and market insight to hiring decisions. You’ll balance strategic partnership with hands-on execution, helping teams make clear, informed decisions while keeping the candidate experience at the heart of what we do.

lists.content:
• Partner closely with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to understand their business priorities and translate them into effective hiring strategies.

  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders, using data, market knowledge, and sound judgment to influence hiring decisions.

  • Advise hiring teams on talent mapping, market dynamics, candidate expectations, and recruiting best practices.

  • Use talent insights to proactively identify opportunities and continuously improve how we hire, partnering with our Talent Intelligence lead as needed.

  • Manage recruiters across the JAPAC/SAMEA Talent Acquisition team, sharing expertise, providing coaching, and helping raise the bar for how we work together.

  • Collaborate with global Talent Acquisition colleagues and cross-functional partners across Spotify, sharing knowledge and contributing to broader talent initiatives.

  • Partner with our Talent Intelligence Lead to leverage market insights and shape targeted hiring strategies and proactive recruitment efforts for niche skills.

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for roles across your area, from intake and talent mapping through interviews, offer, and close.

  • Create an inclusive, consistent, and engaging candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.

• You have experience managing end-to-end recruitment in a fast-moving, complex organization.

  • You build trusted relationships with hiring managers and senior stakeholders and are comfortable constructively challenging thinking and processes when it leads to better hiring decisions.

  • You can translate business priorities into clear and practical talent strategies.

  • You communicate with clarity and empathy and can adapt your approach to different audiences and situations.

  • You know how to manage competing priorities while maintaining a thoughtful and high-quality stakeholder experience.

  • You use data, market insight, and human judgment to anticipate needs, inform decisions and influence.

  • You care deeply about equitable and inclusive hiring and look for ways to build fairness into recruiting processes.

  • You are collaborative, curious, and comfortable navigating change and ambiguity.

• This role is based in Singapore.

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best ! There will be some in-person meetings but it still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come to the office 3 times per week.
